Add the relay ops surface: `share-relay provision` (create one OVH Public Cloud instance per env+region), `share-relay deploy` (render the region's frps/nftables/:80-redirect config, install the pinned sha256-verified frps release + a standalone healthcheck over SSH, and restart the services), `share-relay dns` (gray-cloud A records for the relay host + the region's content wildcard via the Cloudflare API), and `share-relay list` / `destroy`, all wrapped by `just` recipes. The frps plugin auth URL is passed with the shared-secret path segment (sourced from Vault), so the secret never lives in code.

The nftables connlimit sets no longer declare element timeouts (nf_conncount rejects timed elements), and the cloud-init now honestly defers every binary/config install to the deploy step. Verified end to end against a live dev relay: SNI passthrough routes the bare workspace domain and its wildcard sub-origins to the workspace with TLS terminating in the workspace (never at the relay), and the frp 0.70.1 Login/NewProxy plugin payloads match the connector's `/frps/auth` parsing.
